new_cards.name: Vines
new_cards.notes: Released Sep 1 2025 (Season 75). Entangles the 3 highest-HP units in a 2.5-tile radius for 2.5s; grounds air units so ground troops can hit them. Damage: 405 total at launch (162 dps x 2.5s); Sep 5 2025 emergency nerf 162->134 dps (~335 total); further Oct 2025 nerf (numbers not found). Verified: cost/rarity/radius/mechanic; damage approximate.

new_cards.name: Ronin
new_cards.notes: Released Jul 6 2026 (Season 85 Honor & Exile). Melee, ground-only. Parry: every 3.5s blocks one incoming ground melee hit and reflects 200% of it; spawns with parry charged. Aug 2026 bug-fix: first hit time 0.3->0.4s. Damage sources conflict (371 vs 337 at L11); 337 is the more recent figure. Reduced tower damage multiplier (WIP note, unconfirmed).

new_cards.name: Minion Giant
new_cards.notes: Released Sep 7 2026 (Season 87 Minion Academy, Academy Antics album event). Flying building-targeter that spits toxin from 4 tiles. Launch 189 dmg; Sep 16 2026 nerf 189->168 (-11%). All figures community-sourced (LDPlayer/noff/trophycoach), not from Supercell notes.

heroes.note: 'Hero' cards (Dec 2025+) are a second alternate form, separate from Evolutions, with a paid-elixir ability. 18 live as of Oct 2026 per trophycoach. Not in the requested schema; included for completeness.

list.ability: Heroic Hurl: throws the highest-HP enemy troop across the arena
Fiery Flight / Fire Wings: flies and throws fire tornadoes
Banner Brigade: last Goblin drops a banner that calls reinforcements (count 3->2 Aug 2026); ability cost 1->2 Apr 2026
Wounding Warp: warps to lowest-HP enemy
Triple Threat: piercing lane-long arrows; ability cost 1->2 Apr 2026
Coffin Cadets: Skeletons jump off and fight

tower_troops.name: Tower Princess
tower_troops.notes: Default tower troop; hits air & ground. HP from RoyaleAPI Royal Chef comparison; dmg/hit speed from a secondary source (verify).

tower_troops.name: Cannoneer
tower_troops.notes: Epic, Nov 2023 / Arena 8. Hits air & ground; ~4x a Princess arrow per shot but slow (175 dps).

tower_troops.name: Dagger Duchess
tower_troops.notes: Legendary, Apr 2024. Fires up to 8 stored daggers rapidly, then slow recharge when idle. HP/dmg from fandom wiki (older source says 3204/153); hit speed approximate.

tower_troops.name: Royal Chef
tower_troops.notes: Legendary, Dec 2024 / Arena 13. Slightly lower HP and DPS than Tower Princess (damage value not found; hit speed/range stated to match Tower Princess). Starts cooking Pancakes at 7s (18-30s each); a Pancake gives a nearby troop with >=20% HP a +1 level. Oct 2025 HP 2921->2703.
